title: Recruiting Joe Oliver and the uniform money trouble
summary: Keppard says he got Joe Oliver out of butler work to join the Magnolia Band; as manager he chased Oliver, the treasurer, over missing uniform money until the green uniforms arrived. Band then played the lake spots.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
